_comment: SECR-010 -- the declared security posture of every exchange API key this
bot holds. Loaded by src/security/exchange_key_posture.py and asserted at
startup; src/api tests fail if a forbidden capability is declared here.
This file is a declaration, not a capability check. Nothing in this
process can prove the key on the exchange's side matches what is written
here. The operational verification -- attempt a withdrawal, confirm the
venue refuses -- is a documented human step in
docs/security/KEY_MANAGEMENT.md, repeated on every key rotation.
declared_on is the date the posture was last verified against the
exchange's key page, not the date this file was edited.
